honestDefectsVsIntended.detail: All 24 handlers use raw ipcMain.handle with no sender admission (no isTrustedUIRenderer, no trusted-window equality wrapper). Any renderer with the channel name can read usage caches, toggle tracking, and force rescans. Whether this is intended (usage treated as non-sensitive local diagnostics) or a defect is a coordinator decision; do not silently reproduce it in the rewrite without an explicit disposition.

No zod/schema validation on any of the 24 handlers. setEnabled destructures args.enabled (undefined args throws TypeError); refresh tolerates via args?.force ?? false; getSnapshot/getSummary/getDaily/getBreakdown/getRecentSessions destructure args.scope/range/kind/limit (undefined args throws). Scope/range/kind are unvalidated strings passed straight to rollup builders; limit is an unvalidated number passed as recentSessionLimit. Unknown scope/range values do not throw — builders filter to empty projections. Adding validation would change the wire contract; pin current behavior first.

getSnapshot never auto-refreshes (serves last persisted projection) while getSummary/getDaily/getBreakdown/getRecentSessions always refresh(false) first. A reader comparing snapshot.recentSessions (limit 10 default) with getRecentSessions (limit 12 claude/codex, 10 opencode) can see different rows without any concurrent write. Intended or not is unstated in source; preserve the asymmetry until root rules.

Codex store omits jsonIndent (compact cache file) while claude/opencode write indent 2; codex same-version normalize backfills locationModelBreakdown ?? [] while claude/opencode same-version states return untouched. Cosmetic except the backfill, which changes rows on load.

hostBoundaries.registration: registerUsageProviderHandlers({claudeUsage, codexUsage, openCodeUsage}) from register-core-handlers.ts:145; single guarded call (registered flag). No re-registration guard inside the factory itself; no disposer; no sender gate.

operations.errorSemantics: Store getScanState is synchronous pure read (never throws absent programmer error). Handler returns its value directly; rejected promises from async store methods propagate as invoke rejections.
operations.name: getScanState
operations.preload: () => invoke(prefix:getScanState) — zero args; test asserts bare channel with no second invoke arg.
operations.requestShape: No payload. Omitted vs extra args: extras ignored (handler takes none).
operations.resultShape: PublicUsageProviderScanState = {enabled, lastScanStartedAt: number|null, lastScanCompletedAt: number|null, lastScanError: string|null, isScanning: boolean (scanPromise !== null), [dataPresenceKey]: boolean (sessions.length>0 || dailyAggregates.length>0)}. Null vs false vs absent: timestamps null until first scan; error null until first failure (cleared on next start AND on success); presence flag false (never null/undefined) until data exists.
operations.store: lifecycle getScanState (store-lifecycle.ts:68-75): spreads persisted scanState + live isScanning + computed presence flag. No refresh, no disk write, no validation.

operations.errorSemantics: Synchronous TypeError when second invoke arg is undefined (destructuring args.enabled). Non-boolean values stored as-is into scanState.enabled (no coercion, no validation) then persisted; refresh() treats any truthy/falsy via !enabled check. No error channel for invalid input — either throws TypeError or silently persists.
operations.name: setEnabled
operations.preload: (args: {enabled: boolean}) => invoke(prefix:setEnabled, args). Test asserts exact arg passthrough.
operations.requestShape: {enabled: boolean} REQUIRED (destructured at handlers.ts:36). Omitted/undefined whole-args throws; enabled: undefined persists undefined (falsy → tracking off); null likewise. Optional vs required: whole-args effectively required despite no schema.
operations.resultShape: Full PublicUsageProviderScanState AFTER disk write (lifecycle 82-86). Disk write awaited; write failure rejects the invoke.
operations.store: lifecycle setEnabled: assigns, writeToDisk (queued snapshot writer), returns getScanState. No scan triggered (enable-then-fetch is the slice's job, not the store's).

operations.errorSemantics: Disabled store resolves current state without scanning (not an error). Scan throw captured into lastScanError + persisted; invoke still resolves (never rejects on scan failure). Persistence failure after successful scan swallowed (catch () => {}).
operations.name: refresh
operations.preload: (args?: {force?: boolean}) => invoke(prefix:refresh, args). No-args call passes undefined as second invoke arg (test asserts ['prefix:refresh', undefined]).
operations.requestShape: {force?: boolean} optional ENTIRELY: undefined args → false via args?.force ?? false. force: true skips the 5-minute STALE_MS + fingerprint freshness short-circuit; force: false/omitted/null all mean conditional. Unknown keys ignored.
operations.resultShape: PublicUsageProviderScanState after conditional scan. Freshness rule (lifecycle 88-101): disabled → current state; !force && lastScanCompletedAt && ageMs < 300000 && fingerprint unchanged → current state (no scan); else runScan. Concurrent callers share one scanPromise.
operations.store: lifecycle refresh + runScan (126-164): single-flight, startedAt/err reset, fingerprint-gated incremental input (changed fingerprint discards previous source cache for defaults), state replace + startedAt/completedAt stamps, disk write best-effort.

operations.errorSemantics: No auto-refresh: serves whatever is persisted (possibly never-scanned defaults with null stamps and empty arrays) without error. Unknown scope/range strings flow into builders (no throw at this layer). Undefined whole-args throws TypeError on destructure.
operations.name: getSnapshot
operations.preload: (args: {scope, range, limit?}) => invoke(prefix:getSnapshot, args). Test asserts exact object passthrough including limit.
operations.requestShape: {scope, range, limit?: number}. scope/range effectively required (destructured); limit optional, default 10 at ALL three stores (getSnapshot third param = 10). limit: undefined → default; null/0/negative passed through unvalidated to row builders.
operations.resultShape: Full Snapshot: {scanState, summary, daily, modelBreakdown, projectBreakdown, recentSessions}. Claude and codex snapshots expose BOTH modelBreakdown and projectBreakdown (built with kinds 'model'/'project'); opencode likewise. Row-count bound: recentSessions capped by limit (default 10 here).
operations.store: Synchronous pure projection over in-memory state (claude 93-106, codex 97-110, opencode 64-77). No refresh, no disk I/O. Opencode filters via scope-range-filter helpers; claude/codex via build* rollups.

operations.errorSemantics: refresh(false) failure modes inherited (resolve, never reject on scan error). Builder on unknown scope/range yields empty/zeroed projection (not an error).
operations.name: getSummary
operations.requestShape: {scope, range} required; limit NOT accepted (extra keys ignored downstream — handler picks scope/range only).
operations.resultShape: Summary with scope+range echo. Claude: {scope, range, sessions, turns, zeroCacheReadTurns, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, cacheReuseRate: number|null, estimatedCostUsd: number|null, topModel: string|null, topProject: string|null, hasAnyClaudeData}. Codex/OpenCode: {scope, range, sessions→events, cachedInputTokens, reasoningOutputTokens, totalTokens, NO cacheReuseRate/zeroCacheReadTurns/topModel/topProject}. Null vs zero: cost null until priced; reuse rate null until computable; tops null until data.
operations.store: await refresh(false) THEN build from state (claude 108-111, codex 112-115, opencode 79-94). Stale-read impossible here by construction (subject to refresh short-circuit).

operations.name: getDaily
operations.resultShape: DailyPoint[]: Claude {day, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens}; Codex/OpenCode {day, inputTokens, outputTokens, cachedInputTokens, reasoningOutputTokens, totalTokens}. day is a date string; ordering and range-windowing are builder behavior.
operations.store: await refresh(false) then buildDaily (claude 113-119, codex 117-120, opencode 96-109).

operations.errorSemantics: Unknown kind string flows to builders unvalidated (no error at this layer; builder behavior for unknown kind is rollup-body scope, not asserted here).
operations.name: getBreakdown
operations.preload: (args: {scope, range, kind}) => invoke(prefix:getBreakdown, args). Test uses kind 'project'.
operations.requestShape: {scope, range, kind} required. kind: 'model'|'project' by TYPE only — runtime accepts any string. Omitted kind → undefined passed to builder.
operations.resultShape: BreakdownRow[]: Claude {key, label, sessions, turns, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, estimatedCostUsd: number|null}; Codex rows add cachedInputTokens/reasoningOutputTokens/totalTokens and hasInferredPricing: boolean (Codex ONLY — OpenCode rows lack it per diff); key/label identity per kind.
operations.store: await refresh(false) then buildBreakdown(state, scope, range, kind) (claude 121-128, codex 122-129, opencode 111-130).

operations.errorSemantics: Same refresh-then-project discipline. Limit unvalidated (0/negative/huge passed to row builders).
operations.name: getRecentSessions
operations.requestShape: {scope, range, limit?}. Default limit DIVERGES: 12 for claude/codex (stores lines 130-137), 10 for opencode (132-139). limit: undefined → default; explicit values passed through.
operations.resultShape: SessionRow[]: Claude {sessionId, lastActiveAt, durationMinutes, projectLabel, branch: string|null, model: string|null, turns, input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite}; Codex/OpenCode {sessionId, lastActiveAt, durationMinutes, projectLabel, model, events, cachedInputTokens, reasoningOutputTokens, totalTokens, (+Codex only hasInferredPricing)} — NO branch on event-billed providers. Null vs absent: branch/model null until known (Claude); model null (Codex/OpenCode).
operations.store: await refresh(false) then buildRecentSessions (claude 130-137, codex 131-138, opencode 132-147).

providerDifferences.billingModel: Claude counts turns with peer cache buckets (input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite, cacheReuseRate, zeroCacheReadTurns); Codex/OpenCode count events with subset cachedInput + reasoningOutput/totalTokens. Contract header documents WHY no normalized record (usage-provider-contract.ts:1-8).
providerDifferences.breakdownKinds: Identical union 'model'|'project' all three; snapshot always carries BOTH projections regardless of requested kind.
providerDifferences.dataPresenceKeys: hasAnyClaudeData / hasAnyCodexData / hasAnyOpenCodeData — distinct keys, same computation.
providerDifferences.ranges: Identical '7d'|'30d'|'90d'|'all' all three. No runtime validation anywhere.
providerDifferences.schemaVersions: 6 (claude) / 5 (codex) / 2 (opencode); mismatch handling: claude+opencode discard analytics but preserve enabled flag; codex additionally backfills locationModelBreakdown on version match.
providerDifferences.scopes: Identical 'orca'|'all' all three. No runtime validation.
providerDifferences.snapshotExtraKeys: Claude-only: turns, zeroCacheReadTurns, cacheReuseRate, topModel/topProject, branch on sessions. Codex-only: hasInferredPricing on breakdown + session rows. Neither present on opencode rows.
providerDifferences.sourceKeys: processedFiles (claude, codex) vs processedDatabases (opencode); scanner bodies (file vs database ingestion) are the explicit external-provider fixture boundary and were not expanded.

uiConsumption.detail: fetchUsage: getScanState → undefined means paired web client → return (no state change); disabled → stop after scanState write; else getSnapshot({scope, range, limit: 10}) → conditional write (populated only if lastScanCompletedAt !== null or hasCachedData) → refresh({force}) → getSnapshot again (unconditional write). Errors caught+logged, never surfaced to UI. setEnabled writes optimistic scanning state, clears projections, force-fetches when enabling. Scope/range setters update key then fetchUsage. Initial scope 'orca', range '30d', scanState/summary null, arrays empty — all three slices identical except prefix/name/presence-key. Individual getSummary/getDaily/getBreakdown/getRecentSessions channels: NO caller found in the desktop slice; only test-harness mocks reference them — exposed API surface, stated honestly.
uiConsumption.immediateConsumer: Renderer zustand slices (usage-provider-slices.ts:266-299): createClaudeUsageSlice / createCodexUsageSlice / createOpenCodeUsageSlice via shared createUsageProviderSlice factory. Consumed IPC ops per provider: getScanState, setEnabled, refresh, getSnapshot ONLY (4 of 8).
uiConsumption.webFallback: Paired web clients resolve unbridged usage calls to undefined; slice returns early leaving null state (usage-web-client-fallback.test.ts). No throw, no error toast.
